summary: Deepgram gives every new Pay As You Go account $200 in free credits for its speech APIs - Nova speech-to-text, Aura text-to-speech, and the Voice Agent API - with no credit card required and no expiration on the credits.
claim_steps: Create a console account (no credit card needed).
Create an API key in console.deepgram.com.
Call the Speech-to-Text or Text-to-Speech APIs; usage draws down the $200 credit.

social_proof.title: Deepgram Pricing | Scalable Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech & Voice Agent APIs
social_proof.text: Simple, transparent pricing for Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and Voice Agent APIs. Start for free with $2
